subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: After the short-write defect is repaired, should `append: true` become the permanent model-facing write API and `appendFile` a required sandbox bridge capability?
rationale: The change introduces a new agent capability and expands a plugin/harness-facing filesystem contract; mechanical tests cannot determine the intended long-term API boundary.

options.title: Accept optional append mode
options.body: Adopt the proposed API after full-write handling, real sandbox proof, compatibility validation, and owner review.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Keep write overwrite-only and expose append as an independently allowlistable tool and backend capability.

options.title: Defer append support
options.body: Retain current overwrite semantics until maintainers choose a different product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept optional append mode
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed API after full-write handling, real sandbox proof, compatibility validation, and owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The pinned sandbox mutation architecture central to this decision originated in their commit, and the affected subtree has explicit security-owner review requirements.
